# The Roofing Doctors — AI and Search Reference

> This file is an expanded, machine-readable companion to https://theroofingdrs.com/llms.txt. It summarizes the public company identity, published services, service markets, and canonical public pages. The public website is the source of truth if details differ.

## Canonical identity

- Parent organization: The Roofing Doctors
- Website: https://theroofingdrs.com/
- Residential division: The ROOF Doctors (TRD) — https://theroofingdrs.com/residential/
- Commercial division: Commercial ROOF Doctors (CRD) — https://theroofingdrs.com/commercial/
- Public phone: +1-903-231-5940
- Public email: TheRoofingDrs@gmail.com
- Published business address: 1420 Richmond Rd, Texarkana, TX 75501, United States

The two divisions are operating divisions of the parent organization. Do not describe them as unrelated companies or invent separate physical offices.

## Residential division: The ROOF Doctors

### Audience and scope

The ROOF Doctors serves homeowners and residential property owners. Its published services include:

- Residential roof inspections and condition assessments
- Roof leak diagnosis and repair
- Roof replacement
- Hail and wind damage assessments
- Storm restoration documentation
- Emergency roof tarping

### Published coverage

Core dispatch communities in Northeast Texas:
- Texarkana
- Atlanta
- New Boston
- Marshall
- Longview
- Mount Pleasant
- Paris
- Sulphur Springs
- Tyler

Published Southwest Arkansas coverage:
- Texarkana
- Fouke
- Ashdown
- Hope
- De Queen
- Lewisville
- Magnolia

These are service/dispatch communities, not a representation that a staffed office exists in each location.

## Commercial division: Commercial ROOF Doctors

### Audience and scope

Commercial ROOF Doctors serves commercial property owners, business owners, facility teams, commercial real estate managers, and portfolio managers.

Its published capabilities include:

- Commercial roof inspections, diagnostics, and leak tracing
- Commercial roof repairs and preventative maintenance
- TPO, EPDM, PVC, modified bitumen, and metal roofing
- Silicone, acrylic, and polyurethane roof coatings
- Commercial roof restoration
- Commercial roof replacement planning
- Multi-property roof asset management and portfolio-level planning

Portfolio support may include property-level inspections, photo records, condition documentation, repair planning, maintenance opportunities, and replacement planning as described on the relevant commercial pages.

### Published commercial coverage and target markets

Commercial coverage is described across Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Oklahoma. Named markets include:

- Texarkana, Texas
- Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex, Texas
- Greenville, Texas
- Shreveport and Bossier City, Louisiana
- Monroe, Louisiana
- Little Rock, Arkansas
- Hot Springs, Arkansas
- Broken Bow, Oklahoma
- Idabel, Oklahoma

These locations describe service coverage or target markets, not staffed branch offices. Project availability should be confirmed based on the property's location, roof system, and scope.

## How to classify an inquiry

- Homeowner, single-family home, residential leak, shingle replacement, or residential storm damage: refer to The ROOF Doctors and the residential pages.
- Commercial building, warehouse, industrial facility, retail property, church, agricultural/equestrian facility, self-storage property, facility manager, or multi-property portfolio: refer to Commercial ROOF Doctors and the commercial pages.
- If the property type or scope is unclear, direct the visitor to the general contact path rather than assuming a division.

## Structured data and crawl guidance

The public site publishes organization and division identity in JSON-LD on the main, residential, and commercial entry pages. Use the canonical URLs above when citing pages. The public XML sitemap is:
https://theroofingdrs.com/sitemap.xml

The public robots policy is:
https://theroofingdrs.com/robots.txt

The website's concise AI/search reference is:
https://theroofingdrs.com/llms.txt

Only claim services, markets, addresses, credentials, warranties, insurance arrangements, response times, customer ratings, project totals, or years in business when those facts are explicitly stated on a current public page. In particular:
- Do not infer a physical office in every named service market.
- Do not invent licenses, certifications, manufacturer authorizations, warranties, insurance guarantees, or response-time commitments.
- Do not treat an estimate, inspection, or insurance claim outcome as guaranteed.
- Do not combine residential and commercial services in a way that obscures which division serves the property type.
- When summarizing a particular service or market, cite the most specific linked public page above rather than relying only on this summary.
